shippingDeliveryPolicy.title: Shipping & Delivery
shippingDeliveryPolicy.description: At Sam Global, we aim to ensure a seamless delivery experience. This Shipping Policy outlines the terms governing order processing, dispatch, and delivery.

sections.title: Designed for Convenience. Delivered with Care.
sections.description: At Sam Global, we aim to ensure a seamless delivery experience. This Shipping Policy outlines the terms governing order processing, dispatch, and delivery.

points.title: Order Processing
points.description:
Orders are processed within standard business timelines after successful payment confirmation
Processing timelines may vary based on product availability, order volume, or operational factors
Sam Global reserves the right to cancel or delay orders in case of unforeseen circumstances, including stock unavailability or verification issues

points.title: Delivery Timelines
points.description:
Estimated delivery timelines are indicative and will be displayed at checkout
Actual delivery may vary depending on location, logistics partner timelines, and external factors
Delays caused by circumstances beyond our control, including weather, strikes, regional restrictions, or logistics disruptions, shall not constitute a breach of obligation

points.title: Shipping Coverage
points.description:
Delivery is subject to serviceable pincodes as determined by our logistics partners
Sam Global reserves the right to refuse delivery to certain locations without prior notice

points.title: Shipping Charges
points.description:
Shipping charges, if applicable, will be displayed at checkout prior to order confirmation
Charges may vary based on order value, delivery location, product category, or promotional offers

points.title: Order Tracking
points.description:
Tracking details will be shared upon dispatch of the order
The customer is responsible for monitoring shipment updates using the provided tracking information

points.title: Delivery & Acceptance
points.description:
Delivery shall be deemed completed once the order is delivered to the address provided at the time of purchase
Any person available at the delivery address shall be deemed authorized to receive the order on behalf of the customer
Sam Global shall not be liable for loss or damage after successful delivery

points.title: Limitation of Liability
points.description: Sam Global shall not be liable for delays, non-delivery, or service interruptions caused by third-party logistics providers or events beyond reasonable control.

points.title: Need Assistance?
points.description:
For any shipping-related queries, please contact our support team.
Reliable delivery, aligned with clarity and trust.

returnRefundPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
returnRefundPolicy.description: Simple. Transparent. Hassle-Free. This Return & Refund Policy governs the conditions under which returns, exchanges, and refunds are processed.

sections.title: Simple. Transparent. Hassle-Free.
sections.description: This Return & Refund Policy governs the conditions under which returns, exchanges, and refunds are processed.

points.title: Return Eligibility
points.description:
Returns will be accepted only if the product is eligible under the applicable policy
The return request is initiated within the specified return window
The product is unused, undamaged, and in its original condition
Original tags, packaging, and accessories are intact

points.title: Return Process
points.description:
Return requests must be raised through the appropriate platform or support channel
Once submitted, return requests will be reviewed and approved where applicable
Products must be handed over to the return courier as instructed

points.title: Verification & Approval
points.description:
All returned products are subject to inspection and quality checks
Approval of return or refund is at the sole discretion of Sam Global based on product condition

points.title: Refund Process
points.description:
Refunds will be initiated only after successful verification of returned products
Refunds will be processed to the original mode of payment unless otherwise specified
Timelines may vary depending on banking/payment gateway and logistics partner

points.title: Exchange Policy
points.description:
Exchanges are subject to product availability and eligibility
If the requested replacement is unavailable, a refund may be issued as per policy

points.title: Non-Returnable Items
points.description:
Certain products may be marked as non-returnable at the time of purchase
Personalized or hygiene-sensitive items
Products used, damaged, or returned without original condition

points.title: Damaged / Incorrect Products
points.description:
Any claims regarding damaged, defective, or incorrect products must be reported within 48 hours of delivery
Photographic or video evidence may be required for claim review

points.title: Cancellation Policy
points.description:
Orders can be cancelled only within the permitted cancellation window
Once dispatched, cancellation requests shall be treated under the return policy

points.title: Limitation of Liability
points.description:
Sam Global shall not be liable for improper use or handling of products after delivery
Refund liability shall be limited to the value of the eligible product
Delays attributable to banks, logistics, or payment gateways are outside our control

points.title: Need Help?
points.description:
For assistance, please reach out to our support team.
Clarity in process. Confidence in every purchase.
